notes_for_editor: Thin record. The list, the town page and one Commons photo file are the only sources; the photo file page was read but the image itself was not viewed. No source dates the tower, describes its design, staffing or fires, or says whether it stands today. The list spells the name 'oglethorge'; the town is Oglethorpe. The story keeps the list's spelling in quotes and does not propose a rename. The list's 'montezuma' code is not explained by any source read and is not used. A business directory lists a county forestry unit fire tower in Oglethorpe at two different street addresses; that directory refused the fetch (HTTP 403), so it is not used. The photo URL matches the Wikimedia hash path for the file name and returned HTTP 200 (image/jpeg) on the 2026-10-21 check. The photo position is about 54 m from the list point, which supports that the photo shows the listed site. Searches used: 2. Pages read: about 4.
